description: Autopilot in report mode: collects reviews, comments, and check results across your open PRs, verifies bot findings against the code at head, triages CI (introduced vs pre-existing), and returns per-PR items, fix plans, and queued reply drafts. Reads only; never applies fixes or posts comments.
